title: HoldPropagationRecord
description: PACK-09, Framework 0.8.1 section 11. Owned by compliance-service (epd2_compliance_service.domain.HoldPropagationRecord). How far a Legal Hold has ACTUALLY reached: a hold that exists on the primary record but has not reached a replica, index, export or backup is not an effective hold. States unknown, pending and failed all block destruction of the primary record; recording an honest 'unknown' is more useful here than optimistic silence. No field in this payload carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a party or authority handle, a document or its bytes, message content, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13; Framework 0.8.1 section 11).
